---
title: "skemman-harvester"
---

Harvest Icelandic thesis records from [Skemman](https://skemman.is) into a DuckDB
database — **any collection, any year, any degree level**.

Skemman is the shared repository of the Icelandic universities. This tool reads what it
already publishes and turns it into something you can query:

```bash
skemman oai-pmh --location 1946/2064 --year-start 2010 --year-end 2026
skemman metadata-load
skemman files-index
skemman titlepage-load --degree-level master
```

You end up with a DuckDB file holding one row per thesis, normalized authors, advisors and
keywords, and — for open PDFs — the faculty, credits and degree printed on the title page.

## Why the title page matters

Repository keywords are a suggestion. Whoever deposited the thesis typed them, and they
vary by year, by department and by person.

The title page is different. It states the faculty, the degree and the credits outright,
because the university put them there. It also carries fields the metadata does not expose
at all: **ECTS**, and how long the thesis actually is.

When the two disagree, the document wins.

## What it deliberately does not do

- **No logins, no credentials.** Only what Skemman serves publicly.
- **No bypassing access rules.** A file the item page marks `Lokaður` is recorded as closed
  and never requested. Embargo dates are respected by simply obeying them.
- **No hammering.** One request at a time, with a configurable delay — two seconds by
  default.
- **No hoarding.** PDFs are deleted once their first pages are read to text. A full
  master's harvest costs about 20 MB rather than 12 GB.

If you need something outside those lines, this is the wrong tool.
